text.content:
Another Hollow chamber in the Charnel Halls, its purpose only clear in context with what's around it.

GM Notes

Clue: A clue toward the floor's deeper story: Something in the Crypts below is calling the recently dead home, one grave at a time.

Secret: Hidden here: leverage against the Bone Choir that the floor's story doesn't want found.

Encounter: Roll a random encounter check when the party lingers here more than a few minutes - something has noticed them.
